<<On Mending Of Fishing Nets This Season>>  

This season, our neighborhood came together to mend fishing nets, a tradition that strengthens community bonds. Volunteers gathered to repair damaged nets, ensuring safe catches for local fishermen. The effort not only supported the fishing industry but also fostered a sense of unity. Each repair was a reminder of our shared responsibility to care for our resources. This season, we proved that teamwork and care can make a lasting difference.
